prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain consistently too high, overestimating positive impact across all 9 tests.
sign_in hint changes have shown no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign as its 2 tests do not agree (one won, one had no clear effect).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, home notification, and home wait_info as each has only one test so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -8.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Selector: Redesign the choose_path screen into a story scroll layout with interactive mascot elements to guide path selection. (why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean duration of 514s, indicating hesitation during initial path selection.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Grid Layout Account Authentication: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured grid layout highlighting cloud data persistence and restore security. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign_in currently drops 27.1% of users.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Customization Preview Screen: Introduce a dedicated pet preview confirmation screen prior to generating the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (66.2%) and a long mean duration of 1017s, plus support received 3 emails about custom pet generation issues.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Waiting Progress Info: Display active render progress indicators and desktop interaction tips while waiting for pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support logs note user confusion when pets do not appear right away.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Controls Checklist Flow: Embed a structured interactive controls checklist sub-flow into home_intro to teach desktop interaction. (why: Finish drops 35.2% of users with a high mean duration of 5815s, while support received multiple emails about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Duration & Expectation Copy: Update the choose_path screen copy to set clear expectations on setup duration and flexibility. (why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s despite an 8s median, indicating long-tail user hesitation.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Selection Account Authentication Order: Move the sign_in step after pet selection so users establish emotional investment before signing in. (why: sign_in experiences a 27.1% drop early in the process; asking for authentication after pick_friend increases completion motivation.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Spawn Notification: Enable background ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: Mean duration on the waiting screen reaches 2336s, indicating users minimize or walk away while pet initialization finishes.)
